description: Free public price for one coin by slug (for example bitcoin): price in fiat and USD, 24h change, high and low, market cap and rank, 24h volume, and freshness. priceUpdatedAt is when the live price was last written; priceStale:true means it is older than priceStaleAfterHours (72), a last known price, not a live one. marketCapSuspect flags a market cap CoinRithm does not trust. price is null for a coin with no live price. fiatApplied:false means the fiat code is not tracked and the values are USD. candles adds bars over that range, merged to at most maxPoints. coinId is the id get_candles and get_market_context take. Unknown slug: 404. No API key required.

candles.description: Add bars over this range: 1H (1-minute bars), 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M or 1Y (daily).

fiat.description: Currency code such as EUR or JPY (default USD).

slug.description: Coin slug such as bitcoin or tether-usdt (the slug of a get_crypto_movers row).

name: crypto_price
title: Crypto price for one coin
